convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iCCI, iRSI). Simple entry/exit rules with fixed lot sizing. Standard trailing stop logic. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic - only standard Trade library includes for order execution helpers.

derived_values.name: Adjusted point value for 3/5 digit brokers
derived_values.used_by: SL, TP, Trailing Stop, Trailing Step calculations

other_exits: SL sanity check: for BUY, if calculated SL >= Bid then trade is skipped; for SELL, if calculated SL <= Ask then trade is skipped

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CheckVolume validates lot against symbol min/max/step before order send

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires BOTH RSI and CCI to be beyond their threshold levels for TWO consecutive completed bars ([1] and [2]). This is a sustained-level filter, not a crossover. BUY: RSI > 75 AND CCI > 80 on bars [1] and [2]. SELL: RSI < 30 AND CCI < -95 on bars [1] and [2]. Trailing stop activates when position profit exceeds ExtTrailingStop + ExtTrailingStep; then modifies SL to PriceCurrent - ExtTrailingStop (BUY) or PriceCurrent + ExtTrailingStop (SELL). No position gate - EA can open multiple positions if signal persists across bars. Magic number filter applied for trailing stop only.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Both iCCI and iRSI have direct Python equivalents (ta-lib CCI/RSI). Entry logic is a simple threshold-and combination on 2 consecutive bars. Digit adjustment logic (multiply by 10 for 5-digit) must be replicated. Trailing stop is standard: activate when profit > stop+step, then move SL to current_price - stop (or + for short). Note: no position gate means signals can stack positions on every new bar if conditions persist. The Trade library includes are standard MT5 execution helpers - no custom indicator or strategy logic in them.
